# Lulu

> Lulu is a free, open-source macOS app from Falcao SL. Download and run AI models, chat locally in your browser, and serve models through an API on your Mac.

- [Product, demos and downloads](https://lulu.falcaosl.com/)
- [Privacy](https://lulu.falcaosl.com/privacy.html)
- [Releases](https://github.com/Falcao-SL/Lulu/releases)
- [MIT license](https://github.com/Falcao-SL/Lulu/blob/main/LICENSE)

Lulu requires macOS 14 or later. MLX models require Apple Silicon. GGUF models run on Apple Silicon and Intel. The default API endpoint is http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1.

Purge stops the local server, unloads its model and asks macOS to reclaim inactive memory. Reclaiming inactive system memory requires administrator authorization.

Lulu has no accounts or in-app purchases. Release installers are signed and notarized by Apple.
